_comment: Owner-chosen landing page per approved review video. Each entry is bound to the exact video_url, so replaced media loses its landing and is blocked again. path must be a /series/<slug> page or a guide in lib/review-landing.mjs QUALIFYING_GUIDES. vertical states the video's topic (pokemon_tcg or pop_mart) and is only used when the stored row is other_collectible; it must agree with any specific stored topic.
